title: Mirth Connect went closed-source; community needs an open fork
summary: NextGen moved Mirth Connect to a proprietary model with 4.6 (March 2025). OIE exists to continue the last MPL 2.0 code (4.5.2) as a free, community-owned engine with bug and security fixes.
quote: it's disappointing to see the open-source version discontinued.

title: Fear of single-vendor control over roadmap and license
summary: OIE moved to the Eclipse Foundation (incubation Sept 2026) specifically so no company can take the engine private, relicense it or add a paywall; the foundation holds the name and marks.
quote: eliminates concerns over unilateral corporate control of the roadmap

title: Paid extensions for basics (TLS, RBAC, SSO) in Mirth commercial
summary: OIE positions its free TLS plugin and RBAC plugin as replacements for NextGen's paid SSL Manager and User Authorization extensions; all OIE plugins are MPL 2.0 with no paid tier.

title: BridgeLink is open-core: paid tiers and a non-OSS web admin
summary: OIE's comparison criticises BridgeLink for tiered licensing, a WebAdmin under the Business Source License (not usable with other engines), and web-admin plugins that must be compiled in at build time. Community posts call BridgeLink partly commercial.
quote: not an Open Source license

title: BridgeLink: modernise and harden Mirth after it closed
summary: Innovar forked Mirth 4.5.2 (first release March 2025) to provide a maintained, security-hardened open-source engine, keep data under the customer's control and avoid vendor lock-in, monetised through support, training and commercial plugins.
quote: is open source and always will be

title: BridgeLink users ask what the product direction is
summary: A long-time Mirth user asked whether any product direction is materialising for the fork; Innovar publishes release notes but no public roadmap.
quote: I see lots of pinpoints in Mirth after using it for almost 20 years.

title: Vendor-backed hardened OIE builds (Saga OpenShare Engine)
summary: Saga IT ships OpenShare Engine, an OIE downstream with signed installers, a bundled Java 21 runtime and security fixes before upstream lands them, implying users need faster security patches and signed media than upstream provided.

title: Regional/localised Mirth forks (Chinese platform fork)
summary: schic/connect rebrands Mirth in Chinese as a unified health-data exchange and management platform, showing demand for localisation and region-specific forks.

title: Clean-room modern rewrite that keeps the OIE API
summary: A community member proposed a clean-room Python reimplementation of the OIE server that is API-compatible with the web client and existing workflows, judged by functional compatibility rather than code similarity.

title: Commercial support ecosystem for a community engine
summary: OIE governance debated rules for listing vendors that sell support and services, because adopters (especially hospitals) need someone to call; a vendors repository now lists them.

title: OIE roadmap: two feature releases per year
summary: The Eclipse proposal commits to a cadence of two feature releases per year, with near-term work driven by critical vulnerabilities, clinical-safety issues and user-raised GitHub issues.

title: OIE roadmap: broaden native FHIR and new standards
summary: OIE lists support for new healthcare standards and broader native FHIR support as long-term goals; a community FHIR data type with profile validation exists as a third-party plugin.

title: OIE roadmap: improve administrator UX/UI
summary: Enhancing the administrator interface is a stated long-term goal, delivered so far as a web administrator extension (Aug 2026) plus many Swing-client polish issues.

title: OIE roadmap: grow a free plugin ecosystem and accept donated plugins
summary: OIE wants a process for accepting plugins donated by other developers and has shipped free TLS, RBAC, history, Sentinel, thread viewer, SQS, cache and code-search plugins.

title: OIE roadmap: formal clinical safety process
summary: OIE governance proposes a clinical safety process for the project, and the Eclipse proposal names clinical-safety fixes as a near-term priority.

title: Documentation was lost with the Mirth wiki; need user and developer docs
summary: Users and contributors ask where docs live, how to build from source, how to write plugins, and for a docs site cloned from the old Connect wiki; improving documentation is a stated short-term goal.

title: Built-in lookup tables / value mapping with caching (Lookup Manager)
summary: BridgeLink's Dynamic Lookup Gateway adds managed lookup groups with TTL caching, atomic ops and JSON values; users then asked for bulk export/backup, correct SQL Server types and multi-file XSD storage, and reported null lookups.

title: Time-series message statistics dashboard
summary: BridgeLink 4.6.0 added Message Trends: bucketed received/filtered/queued/sent/error counts per channel, connector and server, with retention tiers, charts and a REST API.

title: Manage many engine instances from one place (Fleet)
summary: BridgeLink markets Fleet, a management layer for overseeing multiple BridgeLink instances centrally.

title: Stop phoning home to the vendor
summary: Both forks disabled Mirth's usage/registration call-home; users also flagged unexpected outbound connections from a fresh install.

title: Opt-in anonymous usage statistics for project planning
summary: Maintainers want opt-in, non-intrusive telemetry (OS, JDK, version, feature flags) to win sponsors and prioritise; commenters insist it be off by default and the data or analysis be public.

title: Replace the dated Java Swing/JNLP administrator with a web admin
summary: Both forks built browser-based administrators (BridgeLink WebAdmin, OIE Web Administrator) because the 20-year-old Java client needs a local install and launcher; OIE needed extra engine endpoints to support it properly.

title: Administrator launcher pain after Java Web Start went away
summary: Users need a third-party launcher (Ballista, BridgeLink Launcher) to open the admin client; reports cover wrong URLs, failed upgrades, Java 8 incompatibility, dashboard refresh stalls and login failures through launchers.

title: Keep a GUI Server Manager for DB, ports and logs
summary: A proposal to drop the Server Manager tray tool was reversed after users said newcomers and Windows admins rely on it to switch database backends and change ports without editing config files.
quote: I didn't trust myself to fiddle with config files

title: Admin client is slow to launch and freezes
summary: The client makes one API call per plugin at startup, freezes after long sessions, slows down with the history plugin installed, and can hang on 500 errors.

title: Dark mode for the administrator
summary: Popular request migrated from NextGen's tracker: a dark theme that follows the OS setting, to reduce eye strain.

title: Admin UI does not scale on 4K / HiDPI screens
summary: The Swing UI renders at native resolution so text is nearly unreadable on high-DPI displays; users propose FlatLaf and a scalable interface.
quote: makes text and UI components almost unreadable

title: Copy values out of message and dashboard tables
summary: Users want normal copy commands on grid cells and rows (e.g. message IDs) in the message browser, carried over from NextGen issue 4354.

title: Faster transformer step editing (move to top/bottom, combine, export/import steps)
summary: Migrated NextGen requests: moving steps one position at a time is painfully slow; users want move-to-top/bottom, merge steps into one script, and import/export of steps.

title: Better tooltips and inline help in the admin
summary: Tooltips should explain UI elements well enough to avoid the manual; BridgeLink users note response tooltips omit when responses are sent.

title: 12h/24h time display preference
summary: Users want a preference for 24-hour time in the client and filters.

title: Debug button placed where Deploy used to be
summary: Users accidentally click Debug Channel instead of Deploy because it took the old Deploy position.

title: Show listening ports in channel and dashboard lists
summary: Long-standing NextGen request to add a listening-port column; BridgeLink WebAdmin users ask for ports in the HTTP listener view and CSV export.

title: Errors should stand out on the dashboard
summary: WebAdmin users ask for eye-catching error display and a coloured status grid across messages, channels and dashboard.

title: Search channels by group, OR search, event-type filters
summary: Requests to filter on group names, use OR in dashboard/channel search, and search events by predefined types.

title: Web admin quality-of-life (direct links to filters, expandable text, collapsed trees)
summary: WebAdmin users ask to click straight into filters/transformers from the overview, expand text boxes, default to collapsed message trees, create channels inside a group and see channel scripts more easily.

title: Auto-validate filters and transformers on save
summary: Validate scripts automatically on Save or Save and Deploy so errors are caught before deployment.

title: Test buttons for File Reader and Database Reader sources
summary: Users want connection test buttons on reader source connectors, as exist on some writers.

title: Bulk-edit settings across many channels
summary: Changing one setting (e.g. pruning days) on 100 channels means editing and saving each channel individually.

title: Real-time multi-user collaborative editing of channels
summary: Proposal for concurrent multi-user editing of channels and code templates without conflicts.

title: Concurrent admin sessions silently overwrite each other
summary: Importing a channel in one client deletes code templates created in another client since it last refreshed.

title: White-label: remove or customise branding
summary: Consultants want to strip vendor logos at client sites; OIE centralised branding for easier white-labelling and BridgeLink added custom launcher icons.

title: Administrator crashes on edge inputs
summary: Client crashes when the clipboard holds an image, on Test Write with empty directory, or when a channel uses a missing connector.

title: Role-based access control is missing (default always-allow)
summary: Open-source Mirth authorises every user for everything; users want roles with scoped permissions for audit and multi-team use. OIE shipped a free RBAC plugin; BridgeLink users hit gaps where access control did not cover features.

title: Single sign-on: OIDC, SAML/LDAP, MFA
summary: Users want federated login (OIDC with Azure, Okta, Keycloak, Google) configurable in the admin UI; OIE has LDAP and MFA plugin repos and BridgeLink sells an OIDC plugin.
quote: Passwords suck.

title: Default admin/admin credentials not forced to change
summary: Installs shipped with admin:admin and only documentation advised changing it; OIE 4.7.0 stopped creating it.

title: Password rules only enforced client-side
summary: Password policy is checked by an optional client call; users created via the API bypass it.

title: Username enumeration and invisible login lockouts
summary: Lockout responses reveal valid usernames; admins cannot see or clear a lockout, and failed logins do not record why they failed.

title: Drop legacy password hashes
summary: Maintainers want to drop support for pre-2.2 (2012) password hashes still accepted for in-place upgrades.

title: FIPS-mode incompatibilities
summary: On FIPS-enabled hosts RPM installs fail on MD5 digests, and password changes fail because SHA1PRNG is unavailable (deleting the old credential first).

title: Insecure filesystem and process defaults
summary: mirth.properties and keystore readable by other users, engine running as root/Administrator, and the admin password passed on the command line; BridgeLink 26.3.1 now refuses to start as root.

title: Bundled third-party libraries carry known CVEs
summary: Users repeatedly ask for timelines to fix CVEs in log4j, commons, Jetty, Netty, Derby, Postgres JDBC, HAPI (XXE), iText and others; both forks spent whole releases on dependency CVE cleanup.

title: Engine CVEs: SQL injection and XXE (CISA ICSMA-26-253-01)
summary: Three high-severity engine CVEs (JDBC SQLi, XSLT and XML batch XXE) prompted users of both forks to ask for fix status; OIE 4.7.0 fixed them.

title: Release notes should list fixed CVEs
summary: Security teams need each release to enumerate the CVEs it resolves.

title: SQL statements without bind variables
summary: Internal message-store queries concatenate values instead of binding them, risking injection and defeating plan reuse.

title: HIPAA automatic logoff becoming required
summary: Proposed 2026 HIPAA changes make automatic logoff required, so the admin needs enforced session timeouts.

title: Unsigned installers blocked by Windows security and flagged by AV
summary: Unsigned or expired-cert installers are blocked by Smart App Control/WDAC/AppLocker and flagged by Defender/VirusTotal.
quote: Unsigned executable files (.exe) are frequently blocked in hardened environments

title: Script sandbox hardening removed Java access that channels relied on
summary: After BridgeLink 4.6.0 disabled Java.type/Java.extend, multi-file XSD validation with resource resolvers stopped working.

title: Private vulnerability reporting channel
summary: Users ask for a private security contact and an updated security policy for critical vulnerabilities.

title: Java version policy churn (8 vs 17 vs 21 vs 25)
summary: Long debates over minimum Java (8, 17, 21) and whether to support one or two LTS versions; hospitals in change-controlled environments resist JVM bumps while others want a single bundled JVM. Users also hit hard upper limits on newer Java.
quote: Healthcare enterprises run change-controlled, validated environments.

title: Bundle a known-good JVM with each release
summary: Download stats show most users take the bundled JRE; maintainers propose one embedded, tested JVM per release, and BridgeLink installers now set up Java 21.

title: JavaFX dependency breaks the client on modern JREs
summary: Client features fail or crash on JREs without JavaFX (cryptic pipeline errors, dead tag field); maintainers want to remove JavaFX.

title: Default charset change breaks migrated channels
summary: On Java 18+ the default charset is UTF-8, so channels set to DEFAULT_ENCODING fail on Windows-1252 HL7; users want channels forbidden from using the system default.

title: Locale-dependent failures (Turkish JVM, non-en_US)
summary: Server will not start or deploy channels under a Turkish locale; tests fail on non-en_US systems.

title: Rhino is old; want modern JavaScript (ES2015+) or GraalJS
summary: Rhino 1.7.13 lacks arrow functions, template literals and other modern syntax; maintainers explored migrating to GraalJS and users ask editors to accept modern syntax.
quote: makes writing and maintaining channel scripts unnecessarily difficult

title: Java vs JavaScript type confusion in scripts
summary: Java Strings returned from Java objects behave differently from JS strings (e.g. Array.includes fails); users want automatic conversion.

title: Timeout for JavaScript reader/writer scripts
summary: A JavaScript Reader hung mid-poll and the channel silently stopped for 30+ days; users want a configurable timeout that errors.
quote: When a javascript reader gets "hung", I want an error, not a silent failure.

title: Script editor: formatting, autocomplete, working code assist
summary: Users want format-code actions, trigger autocompletion, a one-click full reference list and code assist that works with modern Java syntax in user utilities.

title: Code template libraries are linked backwards
summary: Libraries list which channels use them instead of channels declaring dependencies, so reusable libraries must be edited for each new channel and are hard to share; maintainers want a normalised schema and CRUD.

title: Code template import/export is fragile
summary: Libraries with same-named functions cannot be imported, exported channels do not carry libraries correctly, and template search/sorting in the dependency dialog is poor.

title: Cloned channels lose their dependencies
summary: Cloning a channel drops its code-template and channel dependencies, so the clone silently breaks.

title: Inconsistent meaning of "message" and status names
summary: The variable named message means different object types in different contexts, TRANSFORMED and response status names confuse users, and outbound templates and {$DATE} mappings trip people up.

title: Undocumented breaking renames of built-in variables
summary: BridgeLink renamed mirth_source/mirth_type to message_source/message_type, breaking migrated transformers, then reverted and changed again across releases.
quote: Undocumented breaking variable name changes

title: Get the raw source message from any script context
summary: Users want a simple way to read the original raw inbound message from destination or postprocessor scripts.

title: Missing context variables in some scripts and templates
summary: channelName is unavailable in the postprocessor and serverName in alert templates.

title: Transformer error stores the wrong transformed message
summary: When a transformer throws, the saved transformed content is the original input rather than the template output, misleading troubleshooting.

title: ConcurrentModificationException under load in scripts
summary: getMergedConnectorMessage and global postprocessor scripts intermittently throw ConcurrentModificationException on busy channels.

title: Configuration Map keys with dots silently fail
summary: Keys like db.warehouse.url are not expanded in connector fields; invalid config-map saves are accepted then lost on restart; some users cannot save the map at all.

title: Case-insensitive comparisons in the rule builder
summary: Rule Builder filters are case-sensitive; non-programmers need a checkbox instead of writing JavaScript.

title: Strict (non-lenient) HL7 date parsing
summary: Out-of-range timestamps like hour 39 silently roll over to the next day; users want strict parsing.

title: UUID v7 generation helper
summary: Users want built-in time-ordered UUID v7 generation in scripts.

title: Community helper libraries to fill scripting gaps
summary: Users publish their own utility libraries (Phantom.js, ~93 helpers for maps, strings, JSON, XML) and a QR code generator, implying a missing standard library.

title: X12 ISA segment does not round-trip
summary: Decoding then encoding X12 with a blank ISA-2 yields an ISA of the wrong length.

title: Strip byte-order marks on receive
summary: Files with a BOM from Microsoft tools fail XML parsing; connectors should detect and strip it.

title: ASTM lab-instrument support
summary: A user built an ASTM JavaScript listener for lab analyzers via serial-to-Ethernet; native ASTM support would help lab integrations.

title: PDF parsing and image manipulation
summary: Users want to read fielded PDFs into XML/JSON and manipulate images inside channels.

title: DICOM Modality Worklist support
summary: Requests in both forks for DICOM Worklist (C-FIND MWL) in the DICOM listener and sender.

title: DICOM connector failures on modern Java and private sequences
summary: DICOM TLS cipher options are disabled by current JDKs, and filters/transformers fail on private undefined-length sequences.

title: Bundled TLS for every TCP-based connector
summary: Mirth open source ships without full TLS; users front it with HAProxy. The most-upvoted BridgeLink request asked to bundle a TLS plugin for all connectors; OIE released one free.
quote: Mirth by default ships without full featured TLS capabilty

title: Native Kafka consumer and producer
summary: Users want built-in Kafka source and destination connectors.

title: WebSocket client connector (e.g. FHIR Subscriptions)
summary: No way for a channel to hold a WebSocket connection, which FHIR R5 Subscriptions backport needs; workarounds live outside the engine.

title: SSH tunnel / port-forward connector
summary: Users run SSH tunnels as OS services for customers; they want tunnels managed as a plugin or destination.

title: HTTP connectors lack configuration knobs
summary: Requests for configurable request/response header size, custom and QUERY methods, local address binding, ordered parameters, forwarded-protocol support and WSDL addresses behind proxies; several shipped in BridgeLink 26.3 and OIE 4.7.

title: Binary/ZIP multipart attachments get corrupted
summary: ZIP files received via HTTP Listener multipart are corrupted during source parsing, and the HTTP Sender cannot set the attachment file name.

title: Rejected HTTP requests leave no trace
summary: When Jetty rejects a request (431/414/400) before the channel, nothing is logged or stored.

title: gzip support on the REST API
summary: HTTP connectors handle gzip but the admin API does not accept gzip-encoded bodies.

title: File Writer: write a header only when the file is created
summary: Append-mode outputs need a header row only on file creation.

title: Limit files read per poll on File Reader
summary: Backloads drop hundreds of large batch files at once; users want a per-cycle file limit.

title: SMTP sender modernisation (OAuth, CC/BCC, Reply-To)
summary: Mail providers require OAuth; users also want complete CC/BCC/Reply-To support in the SMTP sender and API.

title: First-class AWS integrations (SQS, IAM DB auth, SDK jars)
summary: Users want SQS sources, AWS Advanced JDBC with IAM authentication (no static credentials for HITRUST/FedRAMP), and to load AWS SDK jars without manual UI steps.

title: S3 File Writer header bugs
summary: Custom headers are stored as object metadata instead of sent, and their values stick at the first message.

title: Noisy TCP "connection timed out" errors
summary: Self-healing TCP drops log full ERROR stack traces; admins want to downgrade or ignore them.

title: Connector errors do not name the channel/destination
summary: Server log stack traces for connector failures (e.g. TLS client certs) do not say which channel or destination failed.
quote: a good way to get angry from frustration

title: Custom JDBC driver loading breaks
summary: Drivers in custom resources stopped working and driver registration logic is faulty; users struggle with drivers like H2.

title: Message-store database quirks across MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server
summary: Case-sensitive MySQL table names, reserved word Library on MySQL 9.5, Oracle sequence defaults and missing content, SQL Server type mismatches and multi-database logins all break installs.

title: Postgres-only would simplify HA and ops
summary: In the HA discussion a user argued that dropping multi-DBMS support and focusing on Postgres (Patroni, PgBouncer) would make HA achievable.

title: Dynamic per-channel tables break logical replication
summary: The engine creates new tables per channel, which needs manual handling with PostgreSQL logical replication; users want a static schema.

title: Read-replica database split can wipe configuration
summary: With a read/write split and replica lag, the engine can erase all configuration tables.
quote: CRITICAL: CONFIGURATION DATA LOSS RISK

title: Run channels in a group sequentially to protect targets
summary: With 100+ channels, parallel execution overloads target HL7 systems; users want an option to run a group's channels in sequence.
quote: causing too much load on their target HL7 system

title: Per-source rate limiting
summary: A dispensing cabinet sent 3,000 msg/s and exhausted the database; users want per-connection rate limits.
quote: The engine handled it like a champ!  My storage? Not so much.

title: Channel Writer targets should become deploy dependencies automatically
summary: If a channel writes to another channel, that channel should be added to its deploy/start dependencies.

title: Query the DestinationSet in scripts
summary: destinationSet only supports removal; users need to check whether it is empty or contains a destination.

title: Synchronous recursive routing loses responses
summary: A router channel that calls itself on the same port drops the final response to the client.

title: Routed messages missing from source dashboard stats
summary: Messages sent with routeMessageByChannelId are not counted on the source channel dashboard.

title: Message loss risk during channel shutdown
summary: dispatchBatchMessage cannot distinguish shutdown from an empty batch, so messages can be silently dropped.

title: Polling channel cannot redeploy after halt
summary: A halted polling channel cannot be deployed again on the same engine.

title: Cancel a long-running message search
summary: A slow search ties up the GUI and blocks new searches until it finishes; users search daily by accession number.
quote: The GUI is pretty much toast now

title: Index custom metadata columns for search speed
summary: Users assumed custom metadata (MRN, accession) was indexed; searches are slow, so they want automatic indexes.

title: Metadata search bugs (empty values, encrypted columns)
summary: Searching for blank metadata ignores the predicate; with metadata encryption on, metadata searches return nothing; search fails intermittently after metadata changes.

title: Recent search filters
summary: Users want quick reuse of recent message-search filters; OIE 4.7.0 added up to ten per channel.

title: Show message size in bytes per stage
summary: Message size helps with receiver limits and slow transmission triage.

title: Pretty-print map variables in the message viewer
summary: Map values holding XML/JSON should be formatted for readability.

title: Separate pruning retention for errored messages and better defaults
summary: Keep errored messages longer than successful ones, and ship sensible pruning defaults.

title: Lab-report visualiser in the message browser
summary: A plugin that recognises ORU/ADT/MDM and renders them as tables, timelines or charts instead of dense text.
quote: dense, text-heavy, and often require manual parsing

title: Channel export bloated with unrelated tag data
summary: Exported channels embed the IDs of every other channel sharing a tag.
quote: This makes the export ridiculous large

title: Disable reprocessing per channel
summary: Some channels (e.g. query responders) must never be reprocessed by support techs.

title: Reprocessing is slow
summary: Reprocessing a message loads all channels.

title: Per-channel log files
summary: With many channels, support staff need separate, daily-rolled logs per channel; people relied on a third-party appender. OIE users want logs attached to each message.
quote: I can't see using Bridgelink for very many active channels without separate logging

title: Prometheus /metrics endpoint
summary: Kubernetes users want metrics scraped by Prometheus/OpenTelemetry instead of polling the API.

title: Telemetry hooks / message lifecycle SPI
summary: Plugins cannot observe per-message processing; users want a lifecycle listener SPI and telemetry interfaces (e.g. OpenTelemetry).

title: Channel monitoring and alerting beyond built-in alerts
summary: OIE Sentinel added seven monitor types with multiple delivery methods; alert events are not written when a value is null.

title: JVM thread visibility on the dashboard
summary: Thread Viewer plugin adds live thread monitoring, deadlock detection and dump export.

title: Statistics API returns wrong or failing results
summary: Channel statistics endpoint returns another channel's counters and 500s during unrelated undeploys.

title: Audit event forwarding to SIEM/log stacks
summary: Third-party tools forward every engine event as JSON to Loki, syslog or webhooks, indicating demand for audit export.

title: Version history and rollback for channels and templates
summary: Top OIE idea: view history and roll back channels and code templates. BridgeLink ships Git-backed Version History, OIE released a history plugin; users ask to cover global scripts, deletions and better storage.
quote: you will no longer lose track of your code

title: Develop and sync channels from external IDE and source control
summary: Community tools (mirthsync, VS Code extension, mirth-tools) sync channels and templates to Git and editors; users ask why a channel must be deployed to be tested.

title: Official Docker images with automated builds
summary: Users wait on Docker images for new releases and want automated builds, tag pinning, healthchecks and env-var config like the old Mirth image.

title: Container-friendly config: env/layered overrides, read-only filesystem
summary: The engine writes to its own folders and mirth.properties must be re-merged every upgrade; users want default + override files, env vars, site overrides and read-only root filesystems for Kubernetes.
quote: I hate having to re-build mirth.properties and others for each upgrade

title: Validate configuration at startup
summary: Invalid mirth.properties values crash, coerce or are ignored inconsistently; users want fail-fast validation. Startup failures also leave the process running.

title: Native Linux packages (RPM, deb) that work
summary: Users deploy via RPM and see its absence as a switching obstacle; BridgeLink RPM installs failed on RHEL 9 and Linux installers ran Windows binaries.

title: Upgrades break installs and settings
summary: Upgrades reset service startup types, loosen DB settings, fail to start the service, break plugins, and fail to stop a running service; CI does not test upgrades or migrations.

title: Migration from Mirth to a fork hits DB migration errors
summary: DB migration from Mirth 4.5.1 failed, SQL Server migration failed, and restoring pre-4.6 configs re-enabled old default metadata columns.

title: Prove channels behave the same after migrating engines
summary: Teams moving from Mirth 4.5.2 ask how to verify migrated HL7 interfaces behave identically: side-by-side runs, message replay or diffing.

title: Silent installs and configurable install paths
summary: Admins want quiet installs and installer options for appdata, log paths and service type.

title: Modern build and published plugin API
summary: Ant builds and unpublished jars make plugin development tied to an exact release; users want Gradle/Maven, a separately versioned API on Maven Central, and CI that fails on test failure.

title: Admin web UI behind a reverse proxy path
summary: Users want to host the admin at a sub-path and have the server honour forwarded protocol headers.

title: Kubernetes TLS termination and multi-node deployment
summary: Users struggle with TLS termination in Kubernetes; a community image adds multi-node K8s support and BridgeLink offers a Helm chart.

title: High availability / clustering in the free engine
summary: Customers and RFPs require three- or four-nines uptime; options discussed are a clustering plugin or container/cloud HA, with the database as the hard part.
quote: RFPs often have HA requirements in them.

title: Native unit and automated testing of channels
summary: A long-standing wish: test code templates, filters, transformers and connectors outside a deployed channel, possibly by making the engine embeddable; people use JMeter and ad-hoc tools today.
quote: I want a pony.

title: REST API accepts invalid channels that then corrupt messages
summary: POST /api/channels accepted a structurally invalid channel that deployed as healthy and sent undefined content.

title: API returns wrong status codes and inaccurate OpenAPI spec
summary: Malformed dates return 404 instead of 400, the OpenAPI YAML endpoint is broken and does not match responses, and API help links 404.

title: API JSON mangles types and Unicode
summary: JSON responses turn numeric-looking strings into numbers/booleans/null, and Unicode in message JSON is broken.

title: Batch submit should return all produced message IDs
summary: Automation needs every message ID from a batch submission; OIE 4.7.0 added an endpoint for it.

title: CLI is brittle (hangs, Java 17 failures, containers)
summary: The command-line client hangs after failed logins, does not exit on connection failure, fails on Java 17 without add-opens, and does not work in containers; users want env-var substitution in its config.

title: Back up everything including lookup data via API/CLI
summary: Lookup groups are excluded from server backup and cannot be bulk exported; users also share their own backup scripts.

title: Search across all channel and template source code
summary: A third-party plugin added code search across channels, reflecting the need to find where a field or function is used.

title: Shared cache management for scripts
summary: Cache Manager plugin (OIE) and the Lookup Gateway cache (BridgeLink) address the need for managed in-memory caches across channels.

title: Use the engine as an AI agent / AI pipeline hub
summary: Users propose positioning the engine as an AI agent that routes clinical data to models and turns predictions into workflows.

title: Community chat and support channels
summary: NextGen's Slack was unmoderated with limited retention; forks set up Discord/Slack, but users report broken invite links.

title: Formal IP/licence provenance of bundled jars
summary: Eclipse IP review requires every shipped third-party component to be traceable; binary jars with unknown provenance (e.g. iText, mirth-vocab) must be replaced.
